Strategic Bilateral Pacts: Major economies are deploying bilateral critical raw material partnerships and friend-shoring compacts to mitigate supply shock vulnerabilities.

body.text: Extraction Versus Metallurgical Refining

A common analytical mistake is equating mineral ore reserves with supply independence. Australia extracts substantial spodumene rock, and South America's Lithium Triangle (Chile, Argentina, Bolivia) holds massive brines. Yet, converting hard-rock spodumene concentrate into battery-grade lithium hydroxide demands specialized hydrometallurgical calcination and acid leaching infrastructure.

To de-risk sovereign manufacturing pipelines, leading economic blocs are instituting multi-tier safeguards: minimum domestic processing quotas, strategic physical stockpiles, and mandated battery passport tracking to stimulate hydrometallurgical closed-loop recycling.
